Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionFairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players. Experience the all-new Noir Mode, which lets you play the entire story in a striking black-and-white presentation inspired by classic noir cinema. Switch it on at any time to make every interrogation, back alley, and hard choice plays out like the detective film Fabletown always deserved. Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us. Every choice carries consequences. In Fabletown, justice isn’t clean, and sometimes the Big Bad Wolf is the only one willing to do what must be done. Relive where it all began. Key Features - The Complete Award-Winning Story. Experience all five episodes of Telltale’s acclaimed narrative thriller that redefined choice-driven storytelling. - All-New Noir Mode. Experience Fabletown as a classic detective film and play the complete story in a stylish black-and-white noir presentation. With one tap, switch between Noir Mode and the fully remastered look at any time. - Enhanced Visuals and Cinematic Presentation. Improved lighting, updated animation, refined environments, and modernized presentation bring the neon-noir world of Fabletown to life like never before. - Investigate a Dark Fairy-Tale Mystery. Interrogate suspects, examine crime scenes, and uncover a brutal conspiracy where folklore collides with modern crime drama. - Choices That Shape Fabletown. Every decision impacts relationships, dialogue, and how the citizens of Fabletown come to fear, trust, or reject Bigby Wolf. - Bonus Content and Behind-the-Scenes Material. Go behind the scenes with developer commentary, concept art, interviews, restored content, and other archival materials exploring the making of The Wolf Among Us. - The Definitive Way to Experience Fabletown. Rebuilt for modern platforms, The Wolf Among Us Remastered delivers the complete story with enhanced presentation and new supplemental content for longtime fans and newcomers alike.Show morePublished byTelltaleDeveloped byTelltalePlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle playerXbox achievementsXbox presenceXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionQueen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle. Features: Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further! Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration 50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats 20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeatShow morePublished byFuture Friends GamesDeveloped byFreshly Baked Games LLCRelease date10/30/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerXbox achievements XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
